relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-targeted therapies (blue pathway), including monoclonal antibodies (fremanezumab, galcanezumab, eptinezumab, and erenumab) and gepants (atogepant, rimegepant, and ubrogepant), are hypothesized to modulate CGRP signaling

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanical stimulation may promote the release of CGRP and other neuropeptides in the dural vessels (peripheral) and trigeminal nucleus caudalis (central)

key_findings: In 7 SIH patients with comorbid chronic migraine, 5 (71%) met improvement rubric after CGRP-pathway initiation before epidural blood patch; median NRS reduction 3 points.
Orthostatic features persisted until EBP; findings are hypothesis-generating, with migraine biology the leading competing explanation.
